# gyro_backup_space (Resource)

A Gyro Backup Space (Gyro Yedekleme Alanı, region tr-ist-1): an SFTP space with a hard quota, bound to ONE server of the account and reachable only from that server's IPv4 addresses (port 2201, writable directory /veri). Ordered and paid from the account balance (fixed EUR prices charged in the account currency; renews every cycle from the balance). List the plans and the servers it can be bound to with the gyro_backup_space_plans data source (`gyro backup-space plans`). DESTROY DELETES THE SPACE AND EVERY FILE IN IT within about a minute (no snapshot, cannot be undone). Use lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } for backups you must keep. plan and cycle never trigger a replacement: changing them is refused (resize in the panel or with POST /cloud/services/{id}/resize). Tags and project: gyro_service_label, gyro_service_project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# 100 GB SFTP backup space bound to a server of the account, billed monthly from the balance.
# Only the server's IPv4 addresses can connect (sftp -P 2201 <user>@<host>, write into /veri).
resource "gyro_backup_space" "yedek" {
  plan      = "100gb"
  cycle     = "monthly"
  server_id = 12345
  name      = "gyro-proje-yedek"

  # destroy deletes the space and every file in it (cannot be undone)
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

output "sftp" {
  value = "sftp -P ${gyro_backup_space.yedek.port} ${gyro_backup_space.yedek.user}@${gyro_backup_space.yedek.host}"
}

# password is sensitive: pass it to a secret store / configuration, never print it
# gyro_backup_space.yedek.password
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan` (String) Size: 50gb | 100gb | 250gb | 500gb | 1tb (see gyro_backup_space_plans). Cannot change in place.

### Optional

- `cycle` (String) Billing cycle: monthly (default), quarterly, semiannually, annually (only cycles the plan offers).
- `delete_immediately` (Boolean) destroy cancels at once and deletes every file (default). false = file a cancellation request instead (the space keeps working until it is processed).
- `name` (String) Service name (nickname, max 60). Changing it renames the service in place; when not set, the name on the platform is kept.
- `server_id` (Number) Server the space is bound to (one of your active servers). Optional when the account has exactly one. Changing it re-binds the space in place (PUT /cloud/backup-spaces/{id}/server): the old server loses access at once, files are not touched.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) IPv4 addresses of the bound server allowed to connect (follows IP changes of the server automatically).
- `due_date` (String) Next renewal date.
- `host` (String) SFTP host.
- `id` (String) Service id.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SFTP password (GET /cloud/backup-spaces/{id}/credentials; kept in the state - protect the state file). A reset in the panel shows up on the next refresh.
- `path` (String) Writable directory (/veri; the root is read-only).
- `port` (Number) SFTP port (2201).
- `product_id` (Number)
- `service_id` (Number) Service id (number).
- `size_gb` (Number) Hard quota in GB (writes are refused when full).
- `state` (String) pending, active, noserver (no bound server: nobody can connect), suspended, cancelled, purged.
- `status` (String) Service status: active, suspended, cancelled...
- `user` (String) SFTP user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_backup_space.yedek 12345
```
